ctx.x: Patterson, was there a pianist by the name of Patterson?
Yeah, there's Patterson. There's another piano player over there now, you know old-time one. He lives in East St. Louis now. Oh, I can't recall this name.
Somebody told me. I was raised in Missouri too. I was down there several times.
